<!-- Thank you for suggesting a feature! Please fill in as much of the template below as you can. -->

## Feature description

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Problem statement

What problem does this feature solve? Is it related to a specific pain point or inefficiency?

## Proposed solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Include any design ideas, workflows, or examples.

## Script/Workflow type

What type of automation would this be?

- [ ] Deployment script
- [ ] Maintenance script
- [ ] Utility script
- [ ] GitHub Actions workflow
- [ ] Test harness
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Other: _____

## Implementation considerations

- Would this be a new script or modification to an existing one?
- What inputs/parameters would be needed?
- What external dependencies might be required?
- Any security, performance, or compatibility concerns?

## Alternatives considered

What alternative solutions have you considered? Why is this approach preferred?

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Definition of Ready (DoR) Checklist

- [ ] Feature description is clear and complete
- [ ] Problem statement defined
- [ ] Target workflow/script identified
- [ ] Success criteria documented
- [ ] Implementation considerations outlined
- [ ] Dependencies identified

## Definition of Done (DoD) Checklist (for maintainers)

- [ ] Feature implemented according to requirements
- [ ] Tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation created/updated
- [ ] Changelog entry added
- [ ] Feature demonstrated and verified
- [ ] Performance impact assessed (if applicable)
